institutions.name: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland - Bahrain

program.name: Medical Commencement Programme (Certificate in Biomedical Sciences)

requirement.applicantContext: September 2027 entry to Medical Commencement Programme (Certificate in Biomedical Sciences) using the IB Diploma.
requirement.subjectNotes: An applicant below the six-year Medicine IB threshold may be individually considered for the preparatory programme. The committee publishes no separate diploma points threshold here.
requirement.conditions: The general selection and English entry requirements still apply. Completion and the separate progression English test are assessed before the Medicine Foundation Year.

source.title: RCSI Bahrain · Medical Commencement Programme · IB Diploma
source.evidence: on a case by case basis

requirement.applicantContext: September 2027 entry to BSc (Hons) Nursing using the IB Diploma.
requirement.subjectNotes: Pass English, mathematics and a science among the six HL or SL subjects. Every subject must be at least grade 3.
requirement.conditions: Every accepted Nursing applicant must also meet the Aptis requirement. The course does not specify how core points are counted.

source.title: RCSI Bahrain · BSc (Hons) Nursing · IB Diploma
source.evidence: 24 points with no subject grade less than 3
